hero.title:
Small harvests.
Stronger deals.
hero.lead: MandiMate pools harvests from neighbouring farms into lots buyers want, then shows every farmer what they would actually take home — after transport, handling, commission, rejection and the wait for payment — before they agree to anything.

offerA.title: Local trader at the mandi
offerA.terms: Your own vehicle · 8% commission · paid next day

offerB.title: Pooled sale with 2 neighbours
offerB.terms: Shared truck · no commission · paid in {{days}} days

dealCard.summary: Offer B quotes {{gap}} more and saves {{transport}} on transport. After every deduction you keep {{uplift}} more — about on this harvest.

pooling.title: Three harvests. One buyer-ready lot.
pooling.lead: A retailer wants 1,000 kg of consistent tomatoes. No single farm in the village has it. Three neighbours together do — and one truck can collect all of it on a single route.
pooling.note: Estimated with MandiMate’s published vehicle rates for the worked example. Real lots use transporter quotes.
pooling.figureLabel: Farmer A {{a}} kg, Farmer B {{b}} kg and Farmer C {{c}} kg pooled into one {{lot}} lot that fills a {{order}} order
pooling.caption: Each farmer keeps their own share, their own price and their own decision. MandiMate records who contributed what, so payment, grading and any rejection are settled farmer by farmer.

netNotGross.title: The best price is not always the best deal.
netNotGross.lead: A farmer is paid the quoted price minus everything that happens on the way: produce rejected at the gate, the truck, loading and hamali, the agent’s commission, and the weeks of waiting for money. MandiMate puts every one of those on the screen, per kilogram, before the farmer decides.

certainty.confirmed: Written into the buyer’s offer or recorded at delivery. It will not change.
certainty.estimated: Calculated from published rates and local averages. Shown, but clearly marked.
certainty.unresolved: Still open — a transport quote, an inspection, a consent. Never hidden in the total.

netNotGross.tableSubtitle: Worked example · illustrative inputs, published formula
netNotGross.feeNote: MandiMate charges buyers, not farmers: the MandiMate fee line is ₹0 for every farmer.

roles.eyebrow: Built for everyone in the deal
roles.title: One workflow. Four people who need it to work.
roles.lead: A pooled sale only works when farmers, buyers, transporters and coordinators see the same facts. MandiMate gives each of them the view they need — and the farmer the final say.

difference.title: A marketplace finds a buyer. MandiMate finishes the deal.
difference.lead: Discovery is the easy part. The money is won or lost in what comes after — pooling, transport, quality and getting paid.
difference.caption: How MandiMate differs from a typical agricultural marketplace

Explains why a particular deal is better or worse

ai.title: AI to understand. Rules to decide. People to trust.
ai.lead: MandiMate is not “an AI platform for farmers”. AI listens and explains; arithmetic and explicit rules make the decisions; people verify, inspect and consent.

understanding.label: AI for understanding
understanding.title: Voice, languages, photos, messy details
does: “I have 400 kilos of tomatoes ready tomorrow” becomes a draft listing
Explains trade-offs between offers in plain words
Asks for what is missing instead of guessing
understanding.never: Never sets a price, a cost or a grade.

rules.label: Rules for decisions
rules.title: Compatibility, costs, net returns
does: Explicit rules decide which harvests can be pooled
Transport priced from vehicle rates and real quotes
One published formula for every net-earnings figure
rules.never: Never a black box — every line can be checked.

people.label: People for trust
people.title: Verification, inspection, consent
does: Coordinators verify buyers, transporters and harvests
Quality is accepted on inspection, not from a photo
Each farmer accepts or declines; disputes have an owner
people.never: Never a sale without the farmer’s explicit yes.

prove.title: We will publish the results, not the promises.
prove.lead: MandiMate starts small on purpose: one location, one crop, one buyer segment and one complete workflow. Success means one thing — farmers measurably earning more. These are the numbers we will track and share.

metrics.title: Additional net income per kg
